mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.5%, it indicates a tightening labor market that supports economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE < 7.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic activity across the housing sector and labor market, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through combined demand stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and PAYEMS rise, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, as indicated by the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5%, the Fed's policy shift increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 98.0 indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate output and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when INDPRO > 98.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13600), the market becomes overvalued and vulnerable to profit-taking, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months during late-cycle expansion, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235.0, it signals elevated inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth and stock prices, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
